output.brief: The rejects come from a combination, not from the operators or from Arnholt resin alone. Press 5's dryer (D5) is degraded, and Arnholt resin arrives wetter than Quillan. Only that pairing fails. Press 5 with Arnholt rejects about 10%. Press 5 with Quillan rejects 0.9%. Press 7 with Arnholt rejects 0.8%. Second shift looks worse only because all its VX runs on Press 5. The new operators match experienced operators on both resins. An Arnholt lot dried in a good portable dryer and run on Press 5 rejected 0.8%, against 10.4% through D5. I'm fairly confident, about 85–90%. Don't put the six operators on improvement plans, and don't drop Arnholt. Repair D5's heater and desiccant and confirm it reaches −40 °C. Restore the alarm limit that was loosened in week 31. Keep Arnholt off D5 until it is verified. Add a moisture check at the press feed for every VX resin lot. Routing Arnholt only to Press 7 is a stopgap, because it leaves D5 faulty. Arnholt's wetter arrival is confounded with its north-annex storage, so whether storage causes it is unproven. Check that before paying for outside warehouse space.
